weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
Effective against flying foes. If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 during combat and unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

special.d: Doubles damage dealt. Disables non-Special skills that "reduce damage by X%."

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+7 during combat.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Spd (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

c.d: At the start of every third turn, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
At start of odd-numbered turns, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
At start of turn, if Special cooldown count is at its maximum value, grants Special cooldown count-1.
